bug_semantics: Admin Forum Name (Settings.php $mbname / context forum_name) is stored raw. Sources/Actions/Stats.php builds page_title as forum_name plus stats_center. Themes/default/Stats.template.php echoes page_title inside an h3 with no htmlspecialchars. Any visitor of index.php?action=stats, including guests, executes a stored script in that name. index.template.php uses page_title_html_safe; the stats heading does not.
flaw_origin: Smallest surviving first-write of those stats lines is root commit a18e888838460a816fdbc2703e7e05ce7f626c91 (2012 import '10610'): Stats.template.php already echoes $context['page_title'] and Sources/Stats.php already sets page_title from $context['forum_name']. git cat-file -e PARENT fails (no parent). 4cf511ad081e33cd8f120f2458c0e12e09bfff63 escaped $_POST['mbname'] on save; 883a4ee3021fc07a91e36074a3026050becdc014 reverted that and escaped only forum_name_html_safe, leaving the stats sink on the raw field. 121d67a9555a1f576fb4f21991743af2b71bc723 only moved Stats.php.
evidence: CVE.org CVE-2025-67163 state PUBLISHED, not rejected; GHSA-fphf-479j-5c8x withdrawn_at null. Same unescaped page_title concat+echo still at v2.1.6, v2.1.7, and HEAD 68dc36e098e6c465a42a58791afc33b26a0f1771 (Sources/Actions/Stats.php:127 and Themes/default/Stats.template.php:27). Vendor GHSA-p2xm-x9fp-5r7x returns 404. No post-2025-11 commit rewrites that stats heading to forum_name_html_safe.
reasoning: Real CWE-79: stored Forum Name is concatenated into stats page_title and printed unescaped to every stats viewer. Public git's first copy of those lines is root import a18e88883; parent tree is absent so this is the smallest surviving first-write.
